items.title: The Cech chain complex of a family of morphisms is exact away from degree zero
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that for a family U = {U_i -> U} with all fibre products existing, the resulting chain complex of abelian presheaves Z^bullet_U is exact in every degree except zero (statement lines 1628-1638). The proof is a genuine computation in two stages: first the complex is evaluated at an object V and decomposed into a direct sum indexed by the composite morphisms V -> U, which reduces everything to the complex Z[S] <- Z[S x S] <- Z[S x S x S] <- ... for one set S; then an explicit chain map K : n_{(s_0, ..., s_p)} -> n_{(s, s_0, ..., s_p)} is written down and checked to be a nullhomotopy of the alternating-sum operator (proof lines 1687-1694). The author's proof carries a typographical slip in the displayed definition of delta, where the sign is written (-1)^p instead of (-1)^i; it is reproduced verbatim and not corrected. The claim is H2: a concrete homotopy, no citations beyond the definition.
